title: trace scout input
description: One normalized advisory record as fed to Scout. In production, a feed-ingestion step converts NVD/GHSA/OSV payloads into this shape; for v0 tests the shape is produced by hand. Scout consumes this plus a graph-lookup interface and emits either finding.json or a mapping-failure queue entry. No network; no direct feed parsing inside Scout.

aliases.description: Other identifiers for the same advisory (e.g. GHSA-xxxx, OSV id). Not used for mapping yet; preserved for provenance.

cpe_matches.description: CPE identifiers from the advisory. Each MAY carry a version range; the version range is preserved in the output but Scout does not yet evaluate it (that is a graph-layer concern once the full graph exists).

purl_matches.description: Package URLs from the advisory. Preferred over CPE when both are present — purl-exact is a cleaner match surface for most language ecosystems.

pname_hints.description: Optional fallback hints for pname-heuristic matching when CPE/PURL yield no hits. Usually derived by Scout's caller from the advisory's affected-products list.

version_bounds.description: Structured fix-version signals lifted from the source feed (e.g. CVE-list-v5 affected[].versions[].lessThan). Each bound names a product, the version range that's affected, and the version where the fix landed. Source form (lessThan vs lessThanOrEqual etc.) is preserved so downstream code can interpret semantics correctly. Conservative: only emitted for semver version_type in v0; multiple bounds with conflicting fixes are surfaced as separate entries (the resolver picks smallest-upgrade or routes to human review).

product.description: Lowercased product name aligned with pname; matched against GraphMatch.pname.

introduced.description: Range start (CVE-list-v5 'version' field). May be '0' meaning 'all versions before fixed'.

fixed.description: The version named by the fix-bound. Interpretation depends on fixed_kind: lessThan/versionEndExcluding mean 'the fix landed at this version'; lessThanOrEqual/versionEndIncluding mean 'the fix landed at the next version after this'.

provenance.description: How this bound was derived. Absent on the primary path (structured lessThan/versionEndExcluding key, or parsed free-text 'version' field, on a status=affected entry). Present only on slice-5h status-list fallbacks: 'fixed-version-from-status-list' = inferred from a status=unaffected stable-semver entry, expressed as a lessThan equivalent. 'pre-release-from-status-list' = inferred from a status=unaffected pre-release entry when no stable unaffected exists; the resolver's pre-release-target trigger fires on the synthesized target. Commit-hash unaffected entries are not emitted as bounds in v0.

aggregator.description: Optional provenance block recording that this scout-input was produced by normalizing bytes from an aggregator (e.g. Vulnpatch) rather than from direct NVD/GHSA/OSV fetches. Informational; Steward does not consult it. Present only when a feed normalizer emitted this record. feed/source_feeds still reflect the underlying authoritative source so Scout's mapping method and finding source_feeds keep their existing meaning.

primary_source_hash.description: Aggregator's declared hash of the primary underlying source blob.

underlying_source_hashes.description: Per-feed sha256 values reported by the aggregator. Preserved for replay.

epss.description: EPSS prioritization signal. NOT a policy input; queue ordering only.

cisa_kev.description: CISA KEV signal. NOT a policy input; queue ordering only.
